statuses.guidance_and_assisted_preparation: Public guidance, independent preparation and customer-authorized assisted handoff only.
statuses.guidance_and_estimation: Non-binding computations and administrative preparation; never official assessment.
statuses.partner_integration_required: External protocol and signed partner approval mandatory before execution.
statuses.licensed_professional_or_mandate_require: Accredited intermediary and client representation mandate required for restricted work.
statuses.formal_guce_agreement_required: GUCE authorized partnership/protocol required; no credentials reuse or scraping.
statuses.official_validation_agreement_required: Competent authority retains certification or approval and controls integration access.
statuses.accredited_partner_required: Accredited sector professional and authority-approved handoff required.
statuses.authority_or_consultant_approval_require: Formal approval/appropriate professional accreditation where regulated.
statuses.authorized_submission_required: The public authority or its authorized representative controls any submission.
statuses.professional_or_authority_validation_req: Clinical licensing/authorization solely with competent authorities.
statuses.bank_partner_agreement_required: Bank partner agreement and informed customer consent; no credit decisions or custody.
statuses.bank_and_trade_partner_agreements_requir: Licensed banks and permitted trade stakeholders own restricted activities.
statuses.licensed_provider_partner_required: Licensed PSP/bank partnership for regulated payment processing, no fund custody by ADS.
statuses.insurer_or_licensed_intermediary_require: Licensed insurance professionals and carriers control regulated intermediation.
statuses.public_information_only: Sources limited to public official regulatory information until permission is granted.
statuses.mandated_professional_coordination: Case coordination with lawful, explicit scope of representation and authorization.

candidates.name: Business and institutional formalities coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: A managed service that helps new or growing businesses identify registration requirements, assemble documents, follow appointments and retain proof of submissions, with official filings performed through authorized channels.
candidates.commercialModel: business registration and administrative case fees or organizational subscriptions

candidates.name: Tax compliance dossier and deadline manager
candidates.summaryEn: Organize taxpayer obligations, supporting records, returns preparation, filing calendars and correspondence for DGI/DGE/CIME workflows without impersonating the tax authority or issuing official tax documents.
candidates.commercialModel: monthly compliance service and authorized accounting support

candidates.name: Fiscal transaction preparation and authorized submission gateway
candidates.summaryEn: Prepare transaction and invoicing evidence against applicable rules and coordinate authorized filing, submission status and exceptions where the fiscal authority permits a documented integration.
candidates.commercialModel: authorized business API integration and ongoing compliance operations

candidates.name: Import–export trade case coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: Create trade cases, gather declaration documents, track freight and customs milestones, and coordinate licensed customs professionals and approved official channels.
candidates.commercialModel: per-trade-case document management and licensed professional services

candidates.name: GUCE trade-participant onboarding and process integration
candidates.summaryEn: Assist eligible enterprises and accredited intermediaries with GUCE participation readiness and interoperable trade records, without claiming API access or replacing GUCE's official single window.
candidates.commercialModel: contracted enterprise integration and support

candidates.name: Import landed-cost and duty estimation service
candidates.summaryEn: Combine goods value, freight, approved tariffs and tax assumptions into documented landed-cost estimates that are clearly separate from binding customs assessments.
candidates.commercialModel: per-estimate and distributor subscription

candidates.name: Exporter licensing and documentation readiness service
candidates.summaryEn: Prepare sector-specific exporter checklists and document packs, identify responsible authorities, and track evidence for trade authorizations and inspections.
candidates.commercialModel: exporter onboarding and documentation support

candidates.name: Goods origin, certification and provenance dossier operator
candidates.summaryEn: Record source, batch, inspection and certification evidence for agricultural, forest and industrial goods and coordinate authorized validation where required.
candidates.commercialModel: traceability SaaS and evidence management

candidates.name: Product standards and homologation preparation service
candidates.summaryEn: Help producers identify applicable quality or homologation requirements, submit supporting test and product information through approved channels, and track outstanding reviews.
candidates.commercialModel: product dossier preparation and compliance subscription

candidates.name: Agricultural and phytosanitary procedure coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: Organize plant/animal product inspection, traceability and permit documents, with handoffs to competent public authorities or accredited inspection partners.
candidates.commercialModel: export compliance support and per-shipment coordination

candidates.name: Environmental permitting and regulatory reporting assistant
candidates.summaryEn: Track environmental obligations, inspection calendars, supporting reports and permit applications for processing, recycling and industrial operators.
candidates.commercialModel: monthly monitoring and project compliance service

candidates.name: Construction and property approvals coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: Maintain project documentation and permit-readiness checklists, route requests to the competent local authorities and track decision records.
candidates.commercialModel: per-project administrative coordination

candidates.name: Healthcare licensing and facility readiness assistant
candidates.summaryEn: Provide documented checklists for facility and practitioner administrative requirements, renewal tracking and verified institutional correspondence without asserting licensure.
candidates.commercialModel: facility administrative service subscription

candidates.name: Transport operator permits and compliance coordinator

candidates.name: Bank financing application packaging service

candidates.commercialModel: disclosed advisory and authorized referral services

candidates.name: Trade domiciliation and bank documentation coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: Collect and track required trade, banking, and shipping evidence across a transaction and hand cases to authorized financial and trade professionals.

candidates.name: Merchant payment-provider onboarding coordinator
candidates.summaryEn: Support merchants in preparing KYC, business and technical integration packs for licensed payment providers; transactions and customer funds remain with those providers.
candidates.commercialModel: authorized technical integration and merchant onboarding

candidates.name: Insurance document and referral aggregator
candidates.summaryEn: Help businesses organize risk profiles, supporting documents and policy enquiries for participating insurers while reserving underwriting, claims and intermediary activity to appropriately authorized parties.
candidates.commercialModel: authorized broker service and enterprise risk administration

candidates.name: Multi-sector regulatory requirements and renewal tracker
candidates.summaryEn: Maintain a sourced directory of applicable obligations, official updates, filing deadlines and renewal alerts that operators can manage without direct regulator system access.

candidates.name: Multi-agency case preparation and coordination desk
candidates.summaryEn: Let an authorized professional coordinate checklists, client mandates, document requests, staff tasks and correspondence involving several independent agencies from one business dashboard.
candidates.commercialModel: service-centre subscription and per-case preparation
